tasks.label: colcon: build
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && colcon build --symlink-install --base-paths src

tasks.label: ROS DIF: Navigation
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && export IGN_IP=127.0.0.1 GZ_IP=127.0.0.1 && ros2 launch dif_bringup nav.launch.py gui_config:="${workspaceFolder}/src/dif_gazebo/config/gui.config"

tasks.label: ROS DIF: Navigation (headless - faster)
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && if [ -f install/setup.bash ]; then source install/setup.bash; fi && export IGN_IP=127.0.0.1 GZ_IP=127.0.0.1 && ros2 launch dif_bringup nav.launch.py gui:=false
